name: Billboard Voxelization
definition: A two-pass voxelization technique where the first pass renders billboards (instanced quads) into a position map FBO to initialize voxel positions, writing nearest voxel positions to the position FBO.
summary: Billboard Voxelization converts polygonal geometry into a 3D voxel grid by rendering instanced quads to initialize voxel data directly during rasterization, differing from standard methods by avoiding post-processing of surface position textures.
